fixed_single_varied_object.selection_rationale: Seat 1 is the opponent that made the pre-root bet in the conditioned public history, so its range is the one the facing-bet decision is most exposed to. Within that range JhJd is the only combo that beats Hero QsQd on 2c4d7h9sJc (trip jacks with the Jc river), while TcTd is an overpair that loses; scaling exactly that combo therefore moves the mass on the hand that dominates Hero's made hand instead of rescaling the range uniformly.
